description: LST GIS-stöd för små avlopp - StoryMap is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lansstyrelsen.se. The portal shows the English title as "LST GIS support for small sewers - StoryMap" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in INGEN. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://resources.geodata.se/codelist/metadata/anvandningsrestriktioner.xml#CCby4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
